## Find your way to wellness

Nature’s Way offers a diverse range of products designed to support your unique wellness journey.

supplements are rooted in tradition, guided by innovation, and held to the highest quality

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by

strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

## The World’s #1 Direct Selling Business

As the global leader in direct selling, Amway enables anyone to build their own business selling
exclusive health and wellbeing products.

[Our Story][43]

## Founders' Fundamentals and Values

Amway is built on a foundation of guiding principles. We call these principles our Founders'
Fundamentals and Values.
Learn about these principles directly from our Founding Families.

[Our Principles][44]

## Led by business owners

Our Amway Business Owners earn income by recommending and selling our high-quality products and
building a team to do the same. They meet you where you are, with health + wellbeing solutions that
work for your life.

[How Amway Works][45]

## Innovation. Inspired by you.

We're living longer. Let's work toward more robust health that lets us thrive longer, too. Using the
power of plants, proven science, and holistic approaches to help you stay healthy and active -
that's what drives Amway Research & Development.

[Innovation & Science][46]

## Trust begins with transparency

You deserve to know the details of how your products are made – and now, you can. The Amway Tracing
Tool puts traceability in the palm of your hand, where you can discover the stories behind our
products and follow along through each step of their creation journey.

[Start Tracing][47]

# Helping people live better lives.
* [
  [Nutrition][Nutrition]
  ][48]
  
  ### Nutrition
  
  #### PLANT POWERED WELLNESS
  
  Our philosophy is simple: improve the wellbeing of people and the planet. Every Nutrilite™ product
  strives to be good for you, better for the world, traceable and transparent about what’s in that
  product, so you know you’re getting a safe, effective, and responsible option.
  
  [Learn more→][49]
* [
  [Beauty & Oral Care][Beauty & Oral Care]
  ][50]
  
  ### Beauty & Oral Care
  
  #### HEALTHY, LASTING BEAUTY
  
  Beauty goes beyond skincare to include products for body, oral care and hair for a healthy
  approach to your full routine. The science of skin, plant-forward formulas and the power of
  performance: Artistry™ is clean beauty with seed-to-skin traceability.
  
  [Learn more→][51]
* [
  [Home ][Home ]
  ][52]

  Our science-backed products help clean the water you drink and the air you breathe. They help with
  cleaning, laundry, dishes and surfaces, while being safe for people and better for the planet. And
  they help you cook healthy, nourishing meals.
  
  [Learn more→][53]
* [
  [Energy + Sport][Energy + Sport]
  ][54]
  
  ### Energy + Sport
  
  #### Life is an adventure
  
  XS™ Energy and sports nutrition products fuel adventure and the entrepreneurial spirit. XS™
  Fitness helps people meet and exceed their goals. And the XSNation community is built on authentic
  relationships, positive experiences and a lifestyle with people who push themselves and the people
  around them.
  
  [Learn more→][55]

### We inspire achievers

You want the secret to success? There is no secret. It takes hard work. But we’ll help you get
there. We’ve spent years designing and refining a business that puts you in control. We’ll help you
develop an action plan, on-demand training and products to live your healthiest life.

[Learn more][56]

unleash their creative potential.

## Expertise & Professionalism in Halal Assurance

ATASMIYA is dedicated to restoring trust between consumers and producers through a rigorous,
transparent, and professional approach to Halal certification and compliance. Our mission is to
ensure that Halal principles are understood, respected, and verifiably upheld across the supply
chain.

[ Request a Consultation ][41]

### Transparent Audits

### Expert Support

## About ATASMIYA

ATASMIYA is an independent Halal certification and compliance body committed to safeguarding the
integrity of Halal principles. We work closely with food producers, manufacturers, and brands to
ensure that products meet authentic Islamic requirements while complying with modern industry
standards. Our approach is built on trust, transparency, and technical expertise, ensuring
confidence for both businesses and consumers.
[ More About Us ][42]

##### Halal Certification

We provide official Halal certification for food products and production processes, ensuring full
compliance with Shariah principles and recognized Halal standards.

##### Audits & Inspections

Our experts conduct thorough on-site audits covering raw materials, processing, handling, and
storage to verify Halal integrity at every stage.

##### Consulting & Advisory

We support businesses with clear guidance, gap analysis, and corrective actions to help them achieve
and maintain Halal compliance.

##### Brand & Market Support

We assist certified businesses in strengthening credibility, improving Halal communication, and
expanding into global Halal markets.

## Together We Uphold Halal Integrity

ATASMIYA works closely with producers, processors, and brands to ensure Halal compliance is not just
claimed — but **verified, documented, and maintained**. Our certification process combines Islamic
knowledge with technical expertise to protect both faith and consumer trust.

## Our Certification Process

##### Initial Assessment

Review of ingredients, sourcing, and processes.

##### On-Site Audit

Physical inspection of facilities and operations.

##### Compliance Review

Verification against Shariah and Halal standards.

##### Certification Issuance

Official Halal certification upon approval.

##### Ongoing Monitoring

Continuous audits to ensure long-term compliance.

## Ready to Get Halal Certified?

Take the next step toward authentic, Shariah-compliant Halal certification. Our experts are ready to
guide you through a transparent and trusted process.

[ Apply for Halal Certification ][43]

## Our Commitment to Halal Integrity

Halal is not just a label — it is a responsibility.
ATASMIYA emphasizes **proper Halal slaughtering practices**, ethical sourcing, and continuous
verification to ensure that every certified product truly meets Halal requirements.

Our inspections are conducted with care, knowledge, and respect for both religious obligations and
food safety standards.

To ensure maximum freshness, Carlson omega-3s are closely managed from sea to store. We source the

Since 1965, Carlson has been a leader in the vitamin and supplement industry and has won numerous
awards for freshness, potency, purity, and flavor. Carlson was founded by Pharmacist Susan Carlson

families with the highest quality vitamins, minerals, omega-3s, kids’ products and other nutritional
supplements.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about CheckerTR PRO Android service software and licensing.

### What is CheckerTR PRO?

CheckerTR PRO is an all-in-one GSM repair toolkit for professional technicians. It covers IMEI
repair, FRP bypass, data recovery, and flashing for most Android brands.

### Which brands are supported?

We support Samsung, Xiaomi, MediaTek, Qualcomm, Huawei, Oppo, Realme, Infinix, Tecno, and many other
brands with dedicated service modules.

### How can I get a license?

Licenses and credits are sold through our official reseller network. Check our [Authorized
Resellers][49] page for a distributor in your region.

[ [ООО«ЦентрХаляльНадзор» получил международную аккредитацию в Объединенных Арабских Эмиратах] ][69] ### ООО«ЦентрХаляльНадзор» получил международную аккредитацию в Объединенных Арабских Эмиратах ООО «ЦентрХаляльНадзор» вышел на новый этап развития пройдя процедуру Аккредитации в Emirates International Accreditation Centre (EIAC) — государственном органе по аккредитации в Дубае (ОАЭ), известном высоким уровнем требований к органам сертификации и аудита. За стандарт халяль они готовы платить в среднем **на 20% больше.** [Увеличение спроса на халяльную продукцию] ## Увеличение спроса на халяльную продукцию Сертификация халяль **увеличивает** количество потенциальных клиентов в среднем на **25%** и сокращает средства на дополнительные расходы бизнеса на рекламу.
